projects.title: Anonymization quality metrics for survey datasets
projects.description: Design and compare metrics that describe how well survey records are anonymized, using synthetic datasets. Students will implement the metrics and document their limits.

projects.title: Verification workflows for partner research data
projects.description: Map how partner projects request, review and sign off on data access, and propose a lightweight checklist for reviewers.
projects.prerequisites: Interest in policy and process design

projects.title: Audit trail design for shared research accounts
projects.description: Prototype an audit log format that records activity on team-held accounts and makes review simpler.

projects.title: Reliable batch transfer between partner systems
projects.description: Build and test a transfer job with retries, checksums and a manifest, using only generated sample data.

projects.title: Open-source toolkit for student research groups
projects.description: A joint club project to build reusable templates, notes tooling and documentation for student-led research.

projects.title: Privacy-preserving survey analytics
projects.description: Explore aggregation and noise techniques for releasing campus survey summaries without exposing individuals.
projects.prerequisites: Probability; one ML or statistics course

projects.title: Explainable anomaly detection for lab sensor streams
projects.description: Compare simple detectors on time-series data from lab sensors and produce explanations a technician can act on.

projects.title: Ethics and consent in student-linked research datasets
projects.description: A review of consent practices, data minimisation and disclosure in research that uses student information.

projects.title: Knowledge graph of research collaborations
projects.description: Model people, projects and publications as a graph and build simple queries for finding collaborators.

projects.title: Low-power sensor nodes for campus air quality
projects.description: Assemble and calibrate low-power nodes, then collect and visualise readings across campus.

projects.title: Statistical disclosure control: a literature review
projects.description: Prepare a concise review of disclosure control methods, covering their assumptions and typical failure cases.
projects.prerequisites: Interest in literature review and writing

projects.title: Dashboard design for research transparency
projects.description: Design clear, honest dashboards that show what a research system collects, retains and shares.

projects.title: Differentially private release of campus survey summaries
projects.description: Implement and evaluate differential privacy mechanisms on a synthetic survey dataset.

projects.title: Data catalog for partner research archives
projects.description: Prototype a searchable catalog describing datasets, owners and retention rules for research archives.
